plan_a_advantages: Includes strength and mobility work for injury prevention.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a more balanced approach to building aerobic endurance with a focus on consistent, controlled effort across longer runs and shorter recovery sessions. Plan A’s inclusion of strength and mobility work is also a valuable addition for injury prevention and stability, crucial for trail running.  Ultimately, Plan A provides a more targeted stimulus for improving running performance.
